var sc=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene();var go=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Temporary scene review camera");try{var camera=go.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>();camera.orthographic=true;camera.orthographicSize=6;camera.clearFlags=UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;camera.backgroundColor=new UnityEngine.Color(.15f,.18f,.2f);float x=83;float y=-.5f;camera.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(x,y,-20);var rt=new UnityEngine.RenderTexture(1200,800,24);var previous=UnityEngine.RenderTexture.active;camera.targetTexture=rt;camera.Render();UnityEngine.RenderTexture.active=rt;var tex=new UnityEngine.Texture2D(1200,800,UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGB24,false);tex.ReadPixels(new UnityEngine.Rect(0,0,1200,800),0,0);tex.Apply();System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes("scripts/tilemap-pillars-20261110/"+sc.name+"-stairs.png",tex.EncodeToPNG());camera.targetTexture=null;UnityEngine.RenderTexture.active=previous;UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(tex);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(rt);}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(go);}
UnityEditor.Selection.activeGameObject=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name=="Ground — paint here").gameObject;return "Stair region rendered; unified terrain selected";
